The round 8 correction turns the job-ad absence into a displayed job ad. In sign-window B, OrderPassFilm draws HelpWantedSignB at HELP_B.cup (530, 452), a 280 x 322 px board on the window glass. Its charcoal header carries the printed text 'HELP WANTED' (line 434, about 34 px bold cream on charcoal). Below it is a cork board with an empty dashed card slot, unused pin holes, and a clip that opens and snaps shut on nothing within s2-event-1. The sign hangs for the entire shot (7.68 to 10.89 s), covering n2a (8.04 to 10.59 s). A HELP WANTED notice in a storefront window is the public job ad. The header is the largest readable element, and the empty slot under it reads as 'position open, details missing', not 'no ad was posted'. With captions covered, the viewer learns that the restaurant is advertising for staff. With narration on, the picture contradicts the spoken, sourced fact and the s2 to s3 causal chain (no hire, an AI host instead). The board's own s2-frame label ('empty window sign frame with no job ad pinned in it') no longer describes the executed picture. This is also the second rejection of the same empty-slot mechanism: the film rejected the blank card at c3 and the code fails here. Required: change the mechanism. Build a picture in which the job-ad object is visibly not posted, without any displayed hiring notice in the window during n2a. For example, an ad card is set aside unposted while the host panel takes the front-of-house place. The director chooses the technique, but the completed state must read as withheld or absent, never as advertised.
blocking_defects.failed_criterion: Claim c2 ('The family did not post a job ad'; FOX 26: the owner chose not to rush to post job listings) against narration_picture clause n2a. Also the rubric hard fail 'a narrated idea that is not bound to an actual rendered item and visible change', and quality_contract subject_recognition and continuity (no false visual claim).

blocking_defects.defect: The round 8 correction converts an unreadable absence into a contradiction. In OrderPassFilm.tsx case 'sign-window' (B), helpClip(W,t) selects HelpWantedSignB. Required correction: retire the window-sign absence construction entirely (frame, slot, header, clip) in both treatments and replace the whole s2 scene with the source-backed handover in recovery_review. Don't relabel the sign or edit coordinates.
